example_1: The property under sale is identified as House No. {House_Number}, situated on Road {Road_Name}.
example_2: The subject of sale is the immovable property bearing House No. {House_Number}, located on {Road_Name}.
instruction: A clause describing the identification of the house being sold.

example_1: The purchaser has paid an earnest amount of Rs. {Earnest_Money} on {Earnest_Money_Date}.
example_2: An advance sum of Rs. {Earnest_Money} was paid by the purchaser on {Earnest_Money_Date}.
instruction: A clause confirming payment of earnest money.

example_1: The sale shall be completed within {Sale_Period} months from the date of this agreement.
example_2: Completion of sale is agreed to occur within a period of {Sale_Period} months.
instruction: A clause describing the timeframe to complete the sale.

example_1: The sale includes all existing furniture and fixtures as detailed in Annexure A.
example_2: The vendor agrees to sell the property with all movable and immovable furniture currently present.
instruction: Clause specifying whether the house is furnished and what is included.

example_1: The vendor confirms the presence of a pet dog on the premises, and the purchaser agrees to take necessary measures post-possession.
example_2: The purchaser has been informed of a domesticated dog living on the premises and accepts the property accordingly.
instruction: Clause to handle presence of animals on property before handover.

example_1: All outstanding maintenance dues to the society shall be cleared by the vendor before sale.
example_2: The vendor shall submit a No Dues Certificate from the housing society on or before registration.
instruction: Clause confirming society dues will be cleared.

example_1: The vendor shall repay the outstanding home loan on the property before registration.
example_2: All financial liabilities related to any mortgage on the house shall be cleared by the vendor.
instruction: Clause covering mortgage or bank loan clearance prior to sale.

example_1: The property is jointly owned by {Joint_Owner_Name} and consent has been obtained for the sale.
example_2: Both co-owners have signed the agreement to ensure smooth transfer to the purchaser.
instruction: Clause ensuring joint owner consent is taken.

example_1: The vendor is executing this sale under a valid registered power of attorney dated {POA_Date}.
example_2: The representative holds a registered Power of Attorney permitting sale of the subject property.
instruction: Clause when sale is executed by a third-party POA holder.

example_1: The vendor shall ensure the existing tenants vacate the premises prior to registration.
example_2: All existing lease or tenancy agreements shall be terminated before sale completion.
instruction: Clause covering eviction or lease termination before possession.

example_1: The vendor agrees to include the attached servant quarters as part of the sale.
example_2: Servant quarters located within the compound shall be transferred with the main property.
instruction: Clause stating whether servant quarters are part of the sale.

example_1: The installed solar panels shall remain property of the purchaser after the sale.
example_2: Ownership of rooftop solar systems shall be transferred to the buyer at no additional cost.
instruction: Clause concerning installed solar energy infrastructure.

example_1: The modular kitchen and all attached appliances shall be sold along with the house.
example_2: Refrigerator, chimney, and stove installed in the kitchen shall remain post-sale.
instruction: Clause about inclusion of kitchen appliances.

example_1: The vendor confirms that garden space adjoining the property is legally part of the house plot.
example_2: The landscaped garden is included as part of the agreed sale price.
instruction: Clause concerning garden or open land adjacent to house.

example_1: Clubhouse membership linked to the property shall be transferred to the purchaser.
example_2: Access rights to society clubhouse and amenities shall pass to the new owner upon registration.
instruction: Clause on amenities or memberships passed with house.

example_1: The vendor confirms the property has undergone pest control treatment within the last 6 months.
example_2: A pest control certificate will be furnished to the purchaser before registration.
instruction: Clause regarding pest control safety.

example_1: The vendor warrants no known structural damage or defects in the building.
example_2: To the best of the vendor’s knowledge, the property is structurally sound and free from cracks or leaks.
instruction: Clause regarding the structural health of the property.

example_1: The existing generator backup system shall remain installed and functional post-sale.
example_2: The house includes a generator/inverter system included in the sale.
instruction: Clause about backup power systems being included.

example_1: The vendor declares there are no pending disputes with neighbors regarding property boundaries.
example_2: There are no encroachments or claims from adjacent properties on the house.
instruction: Clause for confirming freedom from property line disputes.

example_1: The vendor shall provide an inventory and condition report of all furniture sold with the property.
example_2: Furnishings included in the sale shall be handed over in usable condition as agreed.
instruction: Clause covering condition of furniture and fixtures included.
